findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: inspect_payment · Private data: screen_wallet, verify_us_company, diligence, preflight_payment, get_receipt · Public sink: inspect_payment · Destructive: get_receipt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: inspect_payment · Private data: screen_wallet, verify_us_company, diligence, preflight_payment, get_receipt · Public sink: inspect_payment · Destructive: get_receipt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "screen_wallet" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
